verdict.rationale: dots keeps its own notes about preferences, decisions, and ongoing work for later conversations. Its memory persists across ChatGPT, Slack, Teams, and calls, and users can give standing instructions such as where to report routine progress versus decisions. The action rules in Controls govern how specific actions are handled, which is adjacent rather than response-shaping custom instructions. missing for 10: a documented user-editable custom-instructions or preferences setting applied to every response, user visibility and editing of the remembered preferences, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
